question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external-channel mirroring policy, or keep WebChat deterministically source-only?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally prevent WebChat route inheritance, while the requested feature adds new config and cross-channel delivery behavior with privacy and security implications.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in mirroring
options.body: Approve a narrow default-off policy that mirrors WebChat replies only to an established external deliveryContext with security review, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep WebChat source-only
options.body: Leave deterministic WebChat behavior in place and treat multi-device mirroring as unsupported unless a broader routing design changes that policy.

options.title: Fold into broader routing design
options.body: Track this under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54531 so one design covers force-origin, channel awareness, and WebChat mirroring together.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in mirroring
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow default-off policy that mirrors WebChat replies only to an established external deliveryContext with security review, docs, and regression tests.
